mission_09: Inverse transformation is a critical but often overlooked aspect of data preprocessing. When you scale training data, you must apply the same transformation to test data and eventually inverse-transform predictions back to the original scale for interpretation. In this mission, you will learn how to save scaler objects, apply inverse_transform to recover original values, and verify the accuracy of the recovery. Understanding the reversible nature of scaling transformations is essential for building production ML pipelines where predictions need to be in the original units.
